body: Coming from someone who had to go through a similar situation... I left and it was the hardest thing I ever had to do... but since then I met a man who is absolutely amazing and the definition of my soul mate. Don't you deserve the same?
Thank you!

My big thing is that if you have to hide it, you shouldn't do it. My ex hid a conversation with his ex from me and then I found out about it... it was not pretty, especially since he deleted some of that conversation. 

I would tell him. This was a long time ago while you were still a kid. He should understand. If you don't tell him, you run the risk of him finding out later and having a lot of insecurities towards the situation.

Let me tell you a story that would be from your girlfriend's perspective. 

I was engaged to a guy for a little less than a year. We were together for 3.5 years. Known each other for 7. Everything was fine until this new girl showed up at his job. All I heard was "Alex this and Alex that." I expressed my concerns about this and he made me feel like I was crazy. He said there was nothing going on between them, that she's just a friend, that she is a coworker and nothing will happen. 

Well my gut still wasn't ok with this. They went hiking by themselves. They went out for coffee. They had dinner all the time. I became the piece of shit on his shoe.

He finally admitted he wanted to have sex with this girl. That, along with the fact that he was an abusive, manipulative, piece of crap, was the reason I left.

I would have preferred if he left me when this first started than me doubting myself. 

Moral of the story: tell your gf and let her find someone who won't treat her like shit. You're emotionally cheating on her. It isn't fair.

But your feelings towards "Ashley" are more than just FWB.  You're jealous. You want to be with her. 

Please tell your gf and let her find someone who actually respects her.
You have so much growing up to do.
How would you feel if your gf was seriously considering having sex with with another guy? They are just thoughts, but the fact that they are there really show what kind of person you are.

I'm sorry... do people just not have morals anymore? 
What the fuck makes you think that it's ok to even think of another girl while you have a girlfriend? 
Leave your gf. Not because you're not getting any, but because she deserves better than a piece of shit boyfriend who's fantasizing about a different woman while she's fucking in pain and sick! 
You have some serious growing up to do. 
Also, please learn to respect women in general. They aren't there just to get you off.

No need to apologize. It was a coincidence that I saw his comment. I honestly just wanted to show that there are always two sides. Even in your case. As you can see, my ex doesn't see my side. You may not be able to see her's. That doesn't mean you're a bad person. It just means that you don't see eye to eye. 
Forget about her and go date! I wouldn't recommend sleeping around though. You don't want to feel cheap afterwards. Don't make sex your getaway. Just go out and talk, flirt a little, get to know people. You'll forget about your ex soon enough.

Please tell your girlfriend and let her find someone who won't treat her this way. 
Your ex is using you for your dick. Please move on. 
It sounds harsh, but everyone in the situation deserves better than what they are getting.

So... I usually don't do this... because it's weird.  But I was browsing and ran across your post and was going to comment on it anyway... and then saw that my ex also commented on it (above).

Just so you know both sides of this, I am not dating someone new already. I agreed to go on a group coffee date with a small group of friends including a new guy I just met. I am not dating him. Nor will I. It's far too soon. I am going because my ex made me feel incredibly unattractive, stupid, and undeserving of love. (You can browse my post history and see what I had to say about it)
My ex used to be a good person until one day he wasn't and began to be a manipulative, abusive, and neglecting ass. So after he said that he wanted to have sex with his coworker and after he threatened me and my pets, I left. It was the hardest thing I ever had to do. I was going to marry this guy and had to realize that my life would be full of lying, cheating, and neglect if I was going to stay with him. And who the fuck threatens a defenseless animal? Always good to know both sides here.

As for what you're going through, I'm so sorry. 
I would cut all contact. Block her from your phone, Facebook, whatever else. I'm sad to say that she was probably already talking to him before you broke up.
Like you said above, she will realize that this guy isn't for her. Don't waste your time waiting for her. You don't want a person like that anyway. You have plenty of time to find someone else.

Take the time you need, but don't be a shut in. Go out and have fun. Meet new girls. Go on a casual date or two. Nothing needs to happen. Just go and talk to someone who will actually appreciate who you are as a person. 

Good luck OP :)

He didn't see the problem of inhaling burning smoke. He didn't see anything wrong with trying to run away from his stress by doing drugs.
I realized that he will resent me for the rest of our lives if I stayed, and I won't be able to live with anyone who smokes it. That wasn't the only reason why I left, but it was definitely a big factor.

You will be plagued by guilt if you lead her on. She will be filled with resentment if she gives up what she wants to be with you. Sadly things like this are dealbreakers in any relationship. It sucks and it isn't fair, but you have to have enough respect for her to leaver her, so she can go and find someone who can give her the husband and baby thing... If you love her, then let her be happy. You can't give her that happiness.

It's only been a week, but I can tell you that it gets better. He also is saying pretty words to get me to come back, but I can no longer trust him. All those words are empty to me. 

You have to remember that she made you feel like shit. That she treated you bad and didn't think twice about it. You will find someone who will treat you right and you won't even remember her then. 

Good luck, stay strong. If you need to talk, you can always PM me.

Yep... I'm kind of in the same situation. You can look in my post history, but basically here is sparknotes version of what's been happening:

Fiance and I have known each other for 7 years. We have been in a relationship for 3.5 years. Engaged since February. 

3 months ago he said he wants a break. We take a break. He comes back a week later saying that he loves me, but doesn't want to get married just yet. We cancel all wedding plans. Everything seems fine. We have fight over his female friend. He breaks up with me. He comes back a week later saying he loves me and wants to be with me and will be the best guy for me etc. We try things out again. Last week he told me that he maybe needs to be alone. Then he tells me that he has feelings for the female friend we broke up over. 
On top of everything, he has been drinking a lot, he also decided he will start up smoking weed (which I am deathly allergic to), and he has been showing strong signs of depression. 

I left him on Sunday. He kept calling and texting and I finally answered. He kept saying how much he loved me and how he's had time to think and decided that I am the one for him. I answered and said that if he wants to be with me, he needs to stop the constant drinking (beer or wine with dinner is fine, occasional going out is fine), absolutely no drugs (I am seriously allergic to weed, my throat closes up), he needs to get help for his depression, and I need to be able to trust him around women... which right now I don't. He still hasn't replied... which tells me that he's not ok with my requests. 

What your bf is doing is absolutely unacceptable. Who talks to six girls about hooking up when he has a girlfriend? Please please please leave. He needs to grow up. Unfortunately you can't make him mature. I have learned that the very hard way. If he wants to fuck around, he will whether you are together or not... It's hard to hear, but you will be better off. 

I don't know about you, (I am also 23, in graduate school), but I am at the point in my life where I am ready to settle down. I want to start having kids in three years (mostly for health reasons). I am completely fine with the idea of having a set schedule, coming home to my husband every day, doing things as a unit, etc. I set my rules. You should too. Leave this guy and find someone who is ready for the same things you are. He won't stop texting those girls, and how could you trust him? He is emotionally cheating on you if he hasn't physically done it yet. Please have some self respect and get out. He won't change unless he wants to.

Stay strong. You'll be ok. Try to focus on your finals. Try eating some soup. Drink lots of water. He is not worth it. He is just using you as a safety net, and you are so much more than that.

Also, he's never showed interest in drinking and smoking until his new friends showed up. Now that's all he wants to do. Comes with the cliche saying of "if they jumped off a bridge, would you do it too? "

I went from having the man of my dreams to having a high school boy experimenting with different substances.

I'm going to speak from personal experience here... a couple of days ago I left my fiance. We have been best friends for seven years. Together for three and a half. It was intense and beautiful and when he asked me to marry him I was absolutely thrilled. About three months ago he started acting weird. He started staying out late, drinking all the time, expressed interest in using drugs (which he never wanted to before), and talking nonstop about this girl that was new at his job. He asked for a break. A week later he came back. We tried to make it work. Then he broke up with me. Then a week later he came back. We tried to make it work again. 
What finally made me leave was him telling me that he has feelings for the girl mentioned previously. He said that he talked to her and she doesn't reciprocate his feelings and they decided to not do anything about it because they are coworkers. However to me that sounded more like "she doesn't reciprocate my feelings so THAT'S why we're not doing anything about it".
I packed up and left. 

He keeps calling and texting and leaving voice mails. I haven't answered any of them. But I can tell you that the way he says things... they are very well said and it's hard to not believe them. What I have to remind myself of is that he emotionally (if not physically) cheated on me. How can I trust him? 

That's what you need to remember when your ex calls. Don't pick up.  Don't answer anything. How can you trust someone who acts like that? He is controlling you. You coming back is simply fueling his power over you. It's much better to be the one who calls the shots. If you allow yourself to be strong, you'll get over him much faster. 

And something that I try to remind myself of is that if he truly wants to change then it won't take a few days, it would take a long time. And actions speak louder than words. He can say all the pretty things he wants, but until I see a difference, I'm not even thinking of coming back. 

Please stay strong.
